acceptance_checks.description: `_context/sacred/context.md` exists and its frontmatter `status` field is `authored` (not `seed` — pre-project-interview must have completed Step 4 synthesis)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@analyst pre-project-interview` to complete context.md authoring. Status must be `authored` — a `seed` status means intake ran but Phase 2 interview did not complete.

acceptance_checks.description: User has explicitly accepted `_context/sacred/context.md` as complete (sacred-doc protection becomes active after this sign-off)
acceptance_checks.remediation: Review `_context/sacred/context.md`, confirm its vision + constraints sections are accurate, and sign off. This triggers sacred-doc governance — future changes require the context change-workflow.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/research-synthesis-v1.md` (or higher version) exists — synthesize-research has run at least once
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@analyst synthesize-research` to consolidate Phase 2 research into a synthesis document. This is required for product-brief authoring and Phase 3 tech-stack decisions.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/product-brief-v1.md` (or higher version) exists with frontmatter `status: authored`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@analyst product-brief` to draft and accept the executive product brief. Required before Phase 3 locks the tech stack.

acceptance_checks.description: `_context/planning/idea-validation-v1.md` (or higher) exists — validate-idea ran at least once
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `@analyst validate-idea` for structured problem/market/fit validation. Recommended before Phase 3 — skip only for solo vibe-coder projects with well-understood scope.

acceptance_checks.description: Knowledge graph is not stale — `.coldpress/graph/graph.json` mtime is >= the latest `_input/` file mtime
acceptance_checks.remediation: Run `coldpress graph rebuild` to refresh the knowledge graph. Phase 3 skills query the graph for tech-stack research — a stale graph degrades suggestion quality.

acceptance_checks.description: If any `_input/` file is referenced in the Phase 2 artefacts but contradicts their conclusions, a supersession log entry exists in `_context/audit/supersessions-*.md`
acceptance_checks.remediation: Check `_context/audit/supersessions-*.md`. If a known conflict between `_input/` material and Phase 2 artefacts is not logged, invoke the supersede-check helper (`src/governance/supersede.ts`) for each conflicting document.
